Name: Customer
Description: Individual consumers and B2B customer accounts, their contacts, addresses, consents and account hierarchy.

Name: Product
Description: Products and trade items sold to customers: identification, classification, descriptions, packaging and market availability.

Name: Supplier
Description: Suppliers and vendors: legal entity, sites, bank details, qualification and status.

Name: Employee
Description: Employees and contingent workers: identity, organisation assignment, contact data.

Name: Location
Description: Sites, addresses and geographic hierarchies (country, region, city).

Name: Finance
Description: Financial master data: legal entities of the group, cost centres, chart of accounts, bank accounts.

Name: Asset
Description: Physical and technical assets: equipment, installed base, serial numbers.

Name: Reference data
Description: Shared code lists and reference entities used across domains: countries, currencies, languages, units, statuses.

Name: Medicinal product
Description: Pharma extension. Regulated medicinal and pharmaceutical products, packages, marketing authorisations, IDMP and NDC identification.

Name: Healthcare professional
Description: Pharma extension. Healthcare professionals and organisations (prescribers, teaching hospitals): identity, licences, NPI, specialties, transfers of value.

Name: Clinical site
Description: Pharma extension. Clinical trial sites and investigators: site identity, address, qualification and GxP-relevant status.
